Research at USP

Since its foundation in 1934, USP has played a fundamental role in advancing research in the country, whether in the scientific, technological or social field, thanks to the work done by its students, employees and teachers. Currently, USP is responsible for more than 20% of all scientific production in Brazil

Digital Library of Intellectual Production of USP

The platform gives access to the scientific, academic, artistic and technical production of researchers, plus the theses and dissertations defended since 1985

Dean's Office for Research (Pró-Reitoria de Pesquisa)

Is the central agency responsible for fostering interdisciplinary research and managing programs and policies related to research at the University

USP Journals

Digital library of journals published by teaching and research units, postgraduate programs and research centers of the University of São Paulo and, in some cases, in partnership with external institutions

The Digital Library of Theses and Dissertations

Provides the complete digital version of theses and dissertations defended in master’s and doctoral programs of the University

Technological innovation

The policies of technological innovation at USP are administered by USP’s Office of Innovation, so as to make available to all of society the scientific, technological and cultural knowledge produced by the University. It works in fields such as transfer of technology, USP-business cooperation, university entrepreneurship, sustainability, access to technology, and others.

Libraries

USP has 70 libraries installed in various units of education, museums and research institutes on various campi. These libraries make up USP’s Integrated System of Libraries (SIBi). SIBi manages USP’ Bibliographic Database (Dedalus), which records the collections of the system’s libraries, as well as its scientific output and that of theses/dissertations defended at USP.
